notes:
- New: stop-and-reverse strategies - the opposite signal closes the trade and opens the new one on the same candle (always in the market); stoploss/target from Settings still win if hit first
- New strategy: SuperTrend Flip Reversal - long on green, short on red
- New: RN Fisher RSI and RN Inverse Fisher RSI indicators + strategies (from John Ehlers' published methods) - rising/falling colours, zone-exit signal arrows, optional trend filter, no repainting
- New indicators: MovAvg 2 Lines, MovAvg 3 Lines, EMA 2 Lines, EMA 3 Lines
- New: Universe sessions in Paper Trading (Symbol / Universe / Portfolio)
- New: Paper Trading P&L in money - Unrealized P&L column and a running total above the Trade Log ($ for US/crypto/futures, Rs for NSE/BSE)
- New: Rate RN TradeLab (Help menu) - asks once after 5 days of use; nothing is sent unless you click Send
- Chart: LE = blue right arrow, SE = red left arrow, dotted line green for profit / red for loss; right-edge space only at the end of the data
- The Performance Report and the Portfolio page now fit the window - no sideways scrolling; Portfolio shows In-sample and Out-of-sample side by side
- Fixed: Paper Trading with many symbols (e.g. 50 stocks at 1 min) no longer freezes the app
- Fixed: chart error with True/False indicators; open trades no longer drawn as closed; code editor first-letter clipping; multi-line indicators misaligned on long histories
